modules.module_title: Oversee Baggage and Cargo Handling Operations

Coordinate with the ground service providers to ensure the timely and efficient movement of baggage and cargo

Implement corrective actions to avoid future baggage and cargo handling issues.

Ensure that dangerous goods, restricted items, and special cargo are handled according to the regulatory requirements.
